chunks.text: Today, we will talk about Latvia.
Latvia is a small, green, and peaceful country in Northern Europe.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Latvia?
Latvia is in Northern Europe.
It is one of the Baltic countries, along with Estonia and Lithuania.
Latvia is next to Russia, Belarus, Lithuania, and Estonia.
To the west, it touches the Baltic Sea.
What is the capital city of Latvia?
The capital city is Riga.
Riga is the largest city in Latvia.
It has old buildings, a river, beautiful churches, and museums.
Other towns and cities include Dalgöf Pils, Lipaja, Jormula, a beach town near Riga, Vence Pils.
How many people live in Latvia?
About 1.8 million people live in Latvia.
Many people live in Riga or near the coast.
There are different ethnic groups in Latvia, including Latvians and Russians.
What language do people speak in Latvia?
The official language is Latvian.
It is one of the oldest languages in Europe.
Many people also speak Russian.
In cities and schools, people also speak some English.
What is the weather like in Latvia?
Latvia has a cool climate.
There are four seasons.
Spring, fresh and green.
Summer, warm and sunny.
Autumn, colorful leaves and cooler air.
Winter, cold with snow and short days.
People wear coats and scarves in winter and enjoy long summer evenings.
What does Latvia look like?
Latvia has forests.
They cover over half the country.
Rivers and lakes.
Hills, fields and meadows.
Beaches on the Baltic Sea.
It is a great place for nature walks, camping and bird watching.
What animals live in Latvia?
In Latvia, you can see deer, foxes and hares, wild boars, wolves and sometimes lynx.
Many birds like storks and owls, cows, sheep and horses on farms.
Nature is clean and people love to respect and protect it.
What do people eat in Latvia?
Latvian food is simple, natural and often homemade.
People eat potatoes, cabbage and carrots.
Meat especially pork and sausage.
Fish like herring and salmon.
Rye bread, cheese and sour cream.
Popular dishes, gray peas with bacon, a national dish, cold beet soup, pink and refreshing.
Paraguay, small buns filled with meat or onion.
Cabbage rolls with meat and rice.
Honey cakes, sweet and soft.
What do people drink in Latvia?
People drink water, herbal tea, often made with local plants.
Black tea and coffee.
Milk and fruit juice.
Adults may drink beer or riga black balsam, a strong herbal drink.
Tea is often shared with pastries or cookies in the afternoon.
What is life like in Latvia?
Life in Latvia is quiet, organized and close to nature.
People enjoy spending time with family, walking in the forest, going to the sauna, reading books and listening to music, celebrating with folk songs and dances.
Many people love traditional culture and modern comfort together.
What are some holidays and traditions in Latvia?
Independence Day, November 18.
Midsummer Festival, Johnny, June 23 to 24 with fires and songs.
Christmas and Easter.
Lego night, dancing and wearing flower crowns.
Name days, each name has its special day.
Folk traditions are very important with singing, dancing and nature rituals.
Some fun facts about Latvia.
Latvia has more than 12,000 rivers.
The Latvian flag is one of the oldest in the world, red and white.
Riga has the biggest market in Europe.
Latvians love to sing.
They have song festivals every five years.
The Baltic Way, a peaceful protest started in Latvia.
Now you know many things about Latvia.
You know where it is, what people eat and what they do.
You learned about the seasons, traditions and nature.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
